name: Demas
title: The Fallen Co-worker
summary: Demas was one of the apostle Paul's co-workers in the service of the gospel. He is best known for having left Paul because he loved this present world, and his story serves as a warning about falling away from the faith.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as Paul's Co-worker
keyEvents.description: Demas is mentioned as one of Paul's co-workers who sends his greetings to the church in Colossae, along with Luke.

keyEvents.title: Greeting to Philemon
keyEvents.description: In the letter to Philemon, Demas sends his greetings together with Mark, Aristarchus, and Luke, and is referred to as one of Paul's co-workers.

keyEvents.title: Demas Leaves Paul
keyEvents.description: Paul writes to Timothy that Demas has left him because he loved the present world, and that he went to Thessalonica. This is the most well-known event associated with Demas.

keyEvents.title: A Warning About the World's Allure
keyEvents.description: Demas' apostasy illustrates the biblical warning that love for the world can lead people away from the path of faith and service to God.
